newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won ends up on dlr unwinding, export deals.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won ends up on dlr unwinding, export deals.

text.p: The won closed higher versus the dollar on Friday on the back of month-end export negotiations and heavy dollar positions in the market, traders said.
But the won's strength was limited in the afternoon on dollar short-covering and weakening Japanese yen againt the dollar in world markets.
The won finished at 891.70, up from Thursday's closing of 892.40. It opened at an intraday low of 892.50 and peaked at 890.60.
The mid-rate is expected at 891.40 for Monday, against 893.20 on Friday. -- JEAN YOON (822) 727 5643
